scope.statement: The ritual pack uses a bounded retelling from the reviewed Deshpande English expression of Padma Purana, Uttara Khanda chapter 45. A future story/scripture owner should provide the lawful full expression, Sanskrit and edition coordinates, and reception context while preserving the cosmic amalaki creation, deity locations, social exclusion categories, clay bath, gold Parashurama image, gem jar, lamps, vigil, circumambulation, body-part invocations, recipient hierarchy and attributed results as source facts rather than science, medicine, denial of dignity, universal ritual instructions or guarantees. The hunter/King Vasuratha account is absent from this reviewed expression and must not be silently merged.
